mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_participant (conversation_id, participant_id, participant_type, role, unread_count, join_time, last_read_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{participantId}, #{participantType}, #{role}, #{unreadCount}, #{joinTime}, #{lastReadTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, participant_id, participant_type, role, unread_count, join_time, last_read_time, is_deleted FROM conversation_participant WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND participant_type = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT cp.participant_id AS participantId, cp.participant_type AS participantType, cp.role, cp.join_time AS joinTime, CASE WHEN cp.participant_type = 0 THEN u.name WHEN cp.participant_type = 1 THEN a.name ELSE '系统' END AS name FROM conversation_participant cp LEFT JOIN user_info u ON cp.participant_type = 0 AND cp.participant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON cp.participant_type = 1 AND cp.participant_id = a.id WHERE cp.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND cp.is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, conversation_id, participant_id, participant_type, role, unread_count, join_time, last_read_time, is_deleted FROM conversation_participant WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = 0
